en.copyFailed: Copy unavailable. Select and copy the text above.
en.wifiHelp: Ask your host for Wi-Fi access through your reservation messages. Credentials are not published in this guide.
en.arrivalText: Check-in: {checkIn}. Key collection details are in your reservation messages. If you’re delayed, message your host.
en.parkingText: The current guide lists free private parking. Ask your host for the approved arrival point and parking instructions before driving in.
en.appliancesText: Ask your host through your reservation messages for appliance instructions. Instructions have not yet been approved for this guide.
en.rulesText: Quiet hours: {quietHours}. Only registered guests may stay overnight. Be considerate of neighbours and report damage to your host.
en.contactText: Contact your host through your reservation messages. No public host phone number has been approved.
en.departureText: Check-out: {checkOut}. Check your belongings, close windows, turn off lights and return keys as agreed with your host.
en.englishTips: Local recommendations are currently available in English.
en.routeOverview: Choose a path or trip. Dashed orange: schematic car-train connection.
en.routeOverviewFailed: Some routes could not load. Open Places for trip details.
en.routeDrivingLegend: Solid green: suggested driving route. Walks and gondola rides are not included. Stops are not confirmed parking spaces. Check access and restrictions before travelling.
en.routeFailed: Route unavailable. The destination pin and trip details still work.
en.routeLegend: Solid green: driving · Dashed orange: schematic car-train connection, not the exact railway track. Suggested itinerary, not live navigation. Check Vršič closures and the car-train timetable.
en.mapFailed: Map unavailable. The recommendations below and search still work.
en.mapPrivacy: Opening the map loads OpenStreetMap tiles, which receive your IP address and website origin. Public tiles have no uptime guarantee. Most pins mark places, not routes. Selected trips may include a suggested route. Check access before you go.
en.noResults: No matches. Try Wi-Fi, checkout, parking, pizza or rain.
en.resultScope: Search covers apartment information and all recommendations.
en.advanced: Advanced alpine terrain. Check conditions and take suitable equipment; consider a qualified guide.
en.checkHours: Check opening hours, access and conditions before going.
en.privacyText: Search runs on your device. No tracking, account or installation. Optional tab storage remembers your view and search. This guide is public; never add door codes or reservation details.
en.mapOnly: No map pin supplied. Read the tip below.

sl.copyFailed: Kopiranje ni na voljo. Označite in kopirajte zgornje besedilo.
sl.wifiHelp: Za dostop do omrežja Wi-Fi pišite gostitelju prek sporočil ob rezervaciji. Podatki za dostop niso objavljeni v tem vodniku.
sl.arrivalText: Prijava: {checkIn}. Navodila za prevzem ključev so v sporočilih ob rezervaciji. Ob zamudi pišite gostitelju.
sl.parkingText: Trenutni vodnik navaja brezplačno zasebno parkirišče. Pred prihodom pri gostitelju preverite mesto prihoda in navodila za parkiranje.
sl.appliancesText: Za navodila za uporabo naprav pišite gostitelju prek sporočil ob rezervaciji. Navodila za ta vodnik še niso potrjena.
sl.rulesText: Nočni mir: {quietHours}. Prenočijo lahko le prijavljeni gostje. Bodite obzirni do sosedov in gostitelju sporočite morebitno škodo.
sl.contactText: Gostitelju pišite prek sporočil ob rezervaciji. Javna telefonska številka gostitelja še ni potrjena.
sl.departureText: Odjava: {checkOut}. Preverite osebne stvari, zaprite okna, ugasnite luči in vrnite ključe po dogovoru z gostiteljem.
sl.rescue: Nujna medicinska pomoč, gasilci in gorski reševalci
sl.englishTips: Lokalna priporočila so trenutno na voljo v angleščini.
sl.routeOverview: Izberite pot ali izlet. Črtkana oranžna: shematska povezava z avtovlakom.
sl.routeOverviewFailed: Nekaterih poti ni mogoče naložiti. Za podrobnosti odprite Kraje.
sl.routeDrivingLegend: Polna zelena črta: predlagana pot z avtom. Sprehodi in vožnje z gondolo niso vključeni. Postanki niso potrjena parkirna mesta. Pred odhodom preverite dostop in omejitve.
sl.routeFailed: Pot ni na voljo. Lokacija in podrobnosti izleta so še vedno dostopne.
sl.routeLegend: Polna zelena črta: vožnja · Črtkana oranžna: shematska povezava z avtovlakom, ne natančna železniška trasa. Predlagan izlet, ne navigacija v živo. Preverite zapore Vršiča in vozni red avtovlaka.
sl.mapFailed: Zemljevid ni na voljo. Spodnja priporočila in iskanje še vedno delujejo.
sl.mapPrivacy: Ob odprtju zemljevida se naložijo ploščice OpenStreetMap, ki prejme vaš naslov IP in izvorno spletno mesto. Javna storitev ne zagotavlja stalne razpoložljivosti. Večina oznak predstavlja kraje, ne poti. Izbrani izleti lahko vključujejo predlagano pot. Pred odhodom preverite dostop.
sl.noResults: Ni zadetkov. Poskusite Wi-Fi, odjava, parkiranje, pica ali dež.
sl.resultScope: Iskanje zajema apartma in vsa lokalna priporočila.
sl.advanced: Zahteven visokogorski teren. Preverite razmere in poskrbite za primerno opremo; razmislite o gorskem vodniku.
sl.checkHours: Pred odhodom preverite odpiralni čas, dostop in razmere.
sl.privacyText: Iskanje poteka v vaši napravi. Brez sledenja, računa ali namestitve. Izbirna shramba zavihka si zapomni pogled in iskanje. Vodnik je javen; ne dodajajte kod vrat ali podatkov rezervacij.
sl.mapOnly: Lokacija ni označena. Preberite spodnji nasvet.
